correction_scope: Versioned semantic and accounting correction for the inherited v0.17 baseline locator of Racks Central RCJM1 Phase A (Racks Central Johor AI Campus). The selected geometry is the union of the two named OSM Iskandar Halal Park host-development phases, about 123.31 ha, labelled and counted as a campus locator, and its display anchor lies outside both phase polygons. The numeric MultiPolygon, display anchor, raw capture hashes, physical site, project, identity and construction observation are unchanged. The entity kind, use scope, method, scope class, precision and uncertainty statements, evidence keys and verification posture are corrected to host-development locality context, following the CGK host-estate precedent. No added or removed campus or project, lifecycle refresh, finer location, boundary, precision gain or acceptance claim.

supersedes.correction_reason: The v0.16 seven-country batch turned the operator's locality-only statement (Iskandar Halal Park, Johor; curated method authoritative_locality with null coordinates and geometry) into the topological union of the two OSM Iskandar Halal Park phase polygons labelled geometry_use_scope campus_locator. v0.17 and every v0.18 draft therefore count RCJM1 as a reviewed site locator and publish the planar centroid of the two longitude/latitude rings as its latitude and longitude. The union is about 123.31 ha, about 61 times the five-acre first plot Racks Central reports buying in the park; the anchor lies about 3.3 m outside the Phase 2 ring and inside neither polygon; and no reviewed source places RCJM1 within either polygon.

defect_findings.finding: The selected geometry is the union of the two named OSM Iskandar Halal Park host-development phases (way 639973556 v4, 16 distinct vertices, about 39.76 ha; way 639973557 v3 tagged Phase 2 U/C, 19 distinct vertices, about 83.55 ha; together about 123.31 ha in two disjoint parts about 22 m apart; bounding box about 1.75 km by 2.18 km), labelled geometry_use_scope campus_locator and geometry_source_entity_kind campus. Both RCJM1 curated sources support locality only (method authoritative_locality, null coordinates and geometry). The v0.16 precision text already said the union is not an RCJM campus, RCJM1 or Phase A boundary, yet the row was counted as a reviewed campus locator.

Racks Central reports buying a five-acre (about 2.02 ha) plot in the park in October 2024 and a 14.4-acre (about 5.83 ha) parcel in March 2025, and describes RCJM2A as a 12.9-acre expansion adjacent to the existing RCJM facility. The union is about 61 times the first plot and about 16 times both purchases together, so it cannot discriminate the campus within the host development.

Project and site latitude/longitude publish the planar centroid of the two longitude/latitude rings (103.92817067682181, 1.5324382237091367; v0.16 method planar_multipolygon_centroid). It lies about 3.3 m outside the Phase 2 ring and about 402 m from the Phase 1 ring, inside neither polygon; vertices lie up to about 1.27 km away. The v0.18 shared geometry validator rejects it (polygon display anchor is outside its geometry), so even the CGK-style re-scope cannot pass the current builder unchanged.

No selected site geometry intersects the union among all 200 thirty-sixth-checkpoint sites (Shapely 2.1.1 STRtree); the only intersecting pair remains CGK/STT Jakarta. The nearest selected site is Keppel Genting Lane in Singapore, about 23.6 km from the anchor. Unlike CGK, the defect is scope, anchor and accounting, not a demonstrated collision.

In the 2026-10-08 OSM snapshot no building, construction, data-centre or power feature is mapped inside either phase polygon, and no feature in Malaysia names Racks Central or RCJM (the only Racks Central-tagged feature is its Tai Seng building in Singapore). OSM therefore offers no named campus feature to upgrade to.

RCJM1 is counted in reviewed_site_locator_projects (197 at the thirty-sixth checkpoint) with posture recent_authoritative_physical_observation_plus_reviewed_site_locator. Under the CGK rule a host-development polygon is locality context, not a reviewed locator.

The numbers are a faithful copy: canonical union 927 bytes, sha256 bd636e9b..., reproduced by Shapely unary_union over both Geofabrik 261008 rings, and each ring equals the 261008 GeoPackage polygon vertex for vertex in OGC:CRS84. This is a scope, anchor and accounting error, not a datum or transcription error.

Frozen in v0.17 (projects.csv line 84, sites.csv line 83, evidence.csv lines 215 and 13, sites.geojson feature 81) and copied byte for byte into every v0.18 draft through the thirty-sixth (where the phase-1 evidence line moved to 214 after the CGK drop).
